bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to agriculture; appropriating money for the continuation of the dairy development and profitability enhancement and dairy business planning grant programs.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; DAIRY DEVELOPMENT AND PROFITABILITY ENHANCEMENT PROGRAMS.

$634,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $634,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of agriculture for the continuation of the dairy development and profitability enhancement programs, including dairy business planning grants and other services to support the dairy industry, under Minnesota Statutes, section 32D.30.
additions: APPROPRIATION; DAIRY DEVELOPMENT AND PROFITABILITY ENHANCEMENT PROGRAMS.
